The actual PR change, the waitlist and approval gating for sandbox setup and cluster pairing (TB-013, TB-014), sits at lines 11-39 and was not in these units. Whether the new waitlist gating fails open, for example 'if the coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0.…', needs review against the patch and code units that were not supplied here.
